d:
Josh Hart (10 points, 11 rebounds, 10 assists) recorded a triple-double to propel the Knicks to a 113-106 victory tonight in New York. Pascal Siakam finished with a team-high 25 points along with 6 rebounds and 3 three pointers in the losing effort. The Knicks improve their record to 11-6 with the win, while the Pacers fall to 5-12 for the season.
